from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRetainedEarnings(BaseModel):
    """One company's retained earnings reported in its Form 10-Q for the given period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    retained_earnings_amount: float | None = Field(description="The retained earnings figure as a signed number; negative for accumulated deficit")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, format YYYY-MM")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The actual label used (e.g., 'Retained Earnings', 'Accumulated deficit')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the retained earnings value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_retained_earnings: list[CompanyRetainedEarnings]
